products.name: Krea AI
products.note: Real-time video generation; creative tool; content moderation; emerging platform

profile_text.body:
Krea is a creative AI platform that describes itself as the world's most powerful creative AI suite, offering tools to generate, edit, and enhance images and videos. The platform aggregates and provides access to a wide range of third-party AI models from providers including Google, ByteDance, Minimax, Alibaba, and Qwen, alongside its own tooling, giving users a single interface for image and video generation tasks.

The platform's product, listed as Krea AI, supports real-time video generation and includes content moderation features. Among the models available through the platform are ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 Mini, Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini Omni video model, a Minimax frontier video model rendering at 2K, Alibaba's latest generation video model supporting clips up to 30 seconds at up to 1080p, and FLUX 3, which renders up to 20 seconds of combined image, video, and audio in a single pass. The platform also features Muse, described as a model that searches the web for real references and runs code for precise elements such as charts and QR codes.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Krea.
